== Source, printing and count verification (Story 386) ==
The Players Committee post linked in the article's Sources (WordPress post 34741) was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Kramer DS IE.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card identities displayed in the table. The download's File page attributes it to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The article contains 60 constructed cards and 22 outside-deck cards. The original download contains 60 constructed entries and 22 outside-deck entries. Its unchanged SHA-256 is <code>2d861ef92b0c0652599b5726c652d18d5f2c0ec52ed461690a3c4f2a67e94460</code>. Constructed and outside-deck XML identities were checked separately; outside-deck vehicles and starships retain their own type groups.

=== Printing choices ===
* 1x [[Darth Vader, Emperor's Enforcer (ALT) (Errata)]]: XML <nowiki>208_30^</nowiki>. The explicit image modifier is represented by the matching published ALT face.

GEMP foil-display modifiers retained in the original import: <nowiki>201_39*, 216_8*, 221_35*, 221_38*, 7_312*</nowiki>. These visual settings did not create additional historical foil publications in the article.
